claim_boundary: Capture is not I2 admission, mechanism correctness, external adoption, or L8/L9 credit.
information_barrier: Before prediction freeze, transport may read only the GitHub issues endpoint original issue fields. Comments, linked PR diffs, later commits, maintainer diagnoses, and fixes are forbidden.

new_candidates.body:
Provide a thin Isaac Lab interface to Newton's proposed GPU particle sleeping and bounded evaluation pools, including optional original-ID pages.

Keep activity classification and particle/cache algorithms in Newton. Expose typed runtime settings, preserve default behavior and current dependency pins, invalidate captures only when runtime buffers change, and allow explicit rollout-boundary validation instead of compulsory per-step status readbacks. Guard reset paths so a fault cannot be cleared before collected data is rejected.

A compact moving-sphere-on-sand example demonstrates full-particle, compact, and paged evaluation. This is the Lab companion to [Warp #2267](https://github.com/NVIDIA/warp/pull/2267) and [Newton issue #5216](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton/issues/5216). Feature builds are required until those dependencies land. The draft deliberately excludes the older G1 terrain prototype, visualization mesh framework, and contact projection.
new_candidates.title: Expose optional native MPM sleeping and bounded GPU evaluation
